Implementation Plan Refs #3576. This is the plan for the provenance gate on the `.claude/` live-copy sync, built on the auto-answers Q1: C, Q2: A, Q3: C. One deviation from Q2: A: I added a per-PR commit check (see D3), because without it a squash merge hides any AI editor commits inside the PR. Planning ref: `claude/fix-main-ci-green` @ `af400d9cac61617d69672f971bd02376d7747902`. It matches the issue's integration-branch metadata, so there is no mismatch. Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py Scope-mode justification: The finding's remedy fits inside the existing sync. Today `sync()` in `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` copies every changed template into the live `.claude/` copy and pushes `ai/sync-claude-live-copies` with `GH_PAT`. That opens a normal PR, which `review_autofix.yml` auto-merges. The fix adds a provenance check before the copy. Paths that pass keep today's behaviour exactly. Paths that fail go to a second branch, `ai/sync-claude-live-copies-held`, opened as a **draft** PR, and a Telegram WARNING names the source commits. There is no new script, workflow, supervisor, label or credential. `review_autofix.yml` is not edited: it is 445,389 bytes, and a draft is already a hold every merge path respects. GitHub refuses to merge a draft (HTTP 405). The review gate skips drafts (`SKIP_REASON="draft_or_skip_ai"`). The only `gh pr ready` calls in the pipeline are on the orchestrator's final integration PR (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8367` and `:10656`). Under the Boil the Lake rule I included three small safety steps instead of shortcuts: converting a ready held PR back to draft, a commit cap, and a `(#N)` squash check (D3). Each is a few lines, adds no dependency and no external interface, and closes a real bypass. §6 orders Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed. ## Automation wiring (§20.E) - **Script:** extends the existing `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` (subcommand `sync`). No new script, and no entry in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`. - **Trigger:** `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml`, which runs on `push` to `main` with paths `workflow-templates/.claude/**`. Unchanged. One new alert step is added in the same job. - **Long-running supervisor:** none. - **Database work:** none. - **Credential:** `GH_PAT` stays (Q3: C). The broad credential is recorded as a known limitation in `agents.md` and in a workflow comment. ## Files likely to change 1. `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py`: provenance gate, held-branch flow, `GITHUB_OUTPUT` export, docstring including the new API budget and the limitation. 2. `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml`: add `id: sync` to the existing sync step, add a Telegram alert step, add the `TG_*` and `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL` env vars and a comment about `GH_PAT`. 3. `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py`: update the fake `gh` and the `_gh_json` monkeypatches in the existing sync tests, and add provenance, hold and workflow-contract tests. 4. `agents.md`, section "Live `.claude/` copies and their templates": describe the gate, the held draft PR, the log keys, the API budget and the `GH_PAT` limitation. 5. `changelog.d/6375-claude-live-sync-provenance-hold.md` (new). I assumed this issue is #6375 from the memory record. The implementer should use the real issue number. `review_autofix.yml`, `ci.yml` and `docs/INVENTORY.md` do not change. The script's one-line summary stays the same. ## Functions / modules to implement (all in `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py`) New module constants (names checked as unused in the file): - `HELD_BRANCH_SUFFIX = "-held"` - `PIPELINE_HEAD_RE = re.compile(r"^(ai|orchestrator|auto)/")` - `PIPELINE_MARKER_RE = re.compile(r"^\[(ai-autofix|judge-fix|ai-merge-resolve|claude-[a-z0-9-]+)\]")` - `SQUASHED_PR_RE = re.compile(r"\(#\d+\)\s*$")`, matched against a PR commit's subject - `DEFAULT_MAX_PROVENANCE_COMMITS = 30`, overridable through env `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC_MAX_PROVENANCE_COMMITS`. The default lives in the script (§8). An invalid or non-positive value falls back to 30. New helpers: 1. `_template_commits(root, relative, after) -> list[tuple[str, str]] | None` - Finds the last commit that touched `.claude/` up to `after` (same `git log -1` as `plan()`). - Returns `git log --format=%H%x09%s .. -- workflow-templates/.claude/`. If no live revision exists, it uses the full history up to `after`. - Returns `None` if git fails. - The range is per path, from the live copy's last change, not just `before..after`. That still covers every `before..after` commit (Q2: A), and it also covers the recovery path in `plan()` and carried-forward paths, where unauthorized edits could remain under a later authorized edit. 2. `_commit_authorization(repository, sha, subject, pr_cache, commit_cache) -> tuple[bool, str, str]` returns `(ok, reason, pr)`. - Fails with `pipeline_commit_marker` if `PIPELINE_MARKER_RE` matches the subject. - Calls `GET repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/pulls?per_page=100` once per SHA, cached per run. - Keeps associated PRs whose `merged_at` is set. Fails with: - `no_merged_pr` if none are merged - `pipeline_branch` if any merged PR's `head.ref` matches `PIPELINE_HEAD_RE` - For each merged PR, calls `GET repos/{repo}/pulls/{n}/commits?per_page=100` once per PR (paginated, cached). Fails with: - `pr_commit_marker` if any commit subject matches `PIPELINE_MARKER_RE` - `squashed_pr_commit` if any subject matches `SQUASHED_PR_RE` - `pr_commits_truncated` if 250 or more commits come back (GitHub's cap) - Any `CalledProcessError`, `OSError` or `ValueError`, or a non-list or non-dict shape, fails with `api_failed`. 3. `_classify_paths(root, paths, after, repository) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]]]` returns the authorized list and `held[path] = (reason, commit_sha12, pr)`. - A path is authorized only when it has at least one evaluated commit and every commit is ok. - These are held: zero commits (`no_template_commits`), git failure (`history_failed`), and the distinct-commit cap being exceeded (`provenance_cap_exceeded`). - Logs `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC authorized path=.claude/

commits=` or `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC held path=.claude/

reason= commit= pr=`. 4. `_carry_forward(root, after, branch, paths, drifted) -> tuple[str, list[str]] | None` is the existing block at lines 172–202, factored out unchanged. It returns `(previous_sha, extra_paths)`, or `None` on the existing error paths with the same log reasons. 5. `_commit_and_push(root, branch, after, relatives, previous_sha, message) -> bool`: - `git checkout -B ` with an explicit start point. The second branch must not inherit the first commit. - Copy the files (`mkdir` + `shutil.copy2`, plus the existing `copied path=` log), `git add`, commit as today, then the lease-checked push as today. - Returns `False` with the existing `git_stage_failed` or `push_failed` logs. 6. `_open_or_refresh_pr(repository, owner, branch, base, title, body, *, draft) -> int | None`: - Today's lookup and POST, with `-F draft=true` when `draft` is set. - For a held branch with an open PR whose `draft` is false: call GraphQL `convertPullRequestToDraft(input:{pullRequestId:$id})` using the PR's `node_id` **before** the push. If conversion fails, log `error reason=api_failed stage=convert_to_draft`, return failure and do not push. - Because of that ordering, the held flow is: lookup → convert if needed → push → POST if no PR exists. 7. `_write_outputs(held_pr, held)` appends `held=true|false`, `held_pr=` and a single-line `held_summary` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` when the variable is set. Newlines and control characters are stripped and the summary is capped at about 1,500 characters. Changes to `sync()`: - Reject a `SYNC_BRANCH` ending in `-held` (`unsafe_sync_branch`). The held branch is `branch + HELD_BRANCH_SUFFIX`, which already passes the existing prefix check. - `--dry-run` keeps its current behaviour: it copies every planned path and makes no API calls, because the CI parity preparation step at `ci.yml:401` depends on it. A comment says the gate applies only where a write happens. - Non-dry-run flow: 1. `plan()`. 2. Carry forward from both branches into one deduplicated path set. 3. Run `_classify_paths` on the whole set. 4. Commit, push and open-or-refresh the authorized group on `branch` (`draft=False`, today's title and body). 5. Do the same for the held group on the held branch (`draft=True`). Its title is `chore(.claude): HELD sync of live copies ()`. Its body lists each path with its reason, source commit and PR, and says: "Held as a draft because the template change did not come from an authorized source (sync-claude-live-copies.yml provenance gate). Verify the diff, then mark ready or merge by hand." 6. `_write_outputs`. - Return 1 if any group fails; return 0 otherwise. - New log keys: `held branch=… pr=… paths=…`, `opened pr=… draft=true`, `converted_to_draft pr=…`. The existing `opened` / `updated` lines are kept byte-for-byte for the authorized branch. ## Data structures affected - No persisted state. - Per-run in-memory caches: commit SHA → associated PRs, and PR number → commit subjects. - New `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` keys from the sync step: `held`, `held_pr`, `held_summary`. - New remote branch `ai/sync-claude-live-copies-held`, created only when something is held. ## API / interface changes - CLI flags and subcommands are unchanged. The `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC` prefix is kept and new keys are added. - New optional env var `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC_MAX_PROVENANCE_COMMITS` (default 30). - The workflow sync step gains `id: sync`. Its `run:` line stays byte-identical, because `test_sync_workflow_runs_on_template_pushes_to_main` asserts it. - New step `Alert on held .claude li
